newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH CABLES SAYS TO SEEK LISTING IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH CABLES SAYS TO SEEK LISTING IN 1997.

text.p: Finnish cables maker PK Cables Oy said on Monday it planned to seek as bourse listing in 1997.
"PK Cables ... has started preparations for a listing due to take place later this year," PK Cables said in a statement.
PK Cables said it is Scandinavia's largest manufacturer of cable systems and mobile phone base stations.

"The company's most important clients are among others Scania, Volvo Trucks Corporation, Nokia Telecommunications, Nokia Mobile Phones and ABB," PK Cables said, adding that it had chosen Carnegie as advisor.
PK Cables' 1996 profit after financial items was 37.2 million markka, up from 29.2 million in 1995. Its 1996 net sales were 260.1 million markka, up from 183.8 million.
